svg.title: Languages and tools
svg.desc: Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C#, Java, C++, SQL. Front end: React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS. Back end: Node.js, Fastify, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Stripe. Testing, ops: Playwright, Vitest, Cloudflare, Nginx, Sentry. Most interested in product engineering, applied AI and software that has to survive contact with real users.
